title: Revise Queue tab launch-scope IA
summary: Revised Queue tab information architecture so pre-launch queue evidence separates loaded, filtered, selected, and backend-owned launch scope. Added Queue Decision and Attention Required summaries, promoted backend scope boundary and Queue-to-Launch handoff, moved selected-row diagnostics beside detail, and aligned Launch-side copy to backend queue scope.
reason: Operators needed clearer Queue evidence for daily launch judgment without implying WebView filters, rendered rows, or row selection define backend processing scope.
behavior_before: Queue placed filters first, kept launch-scope evidence lower/advanced, used launch/checklist labels that could read as authorization, and diagnostics links were separated from selected row detail.
behavior_after: Queue starts with a decision header, display filter controls, attention summary, rows, selected-row detail with diagnostics links, backend launch scope boundary, and Queue-to-Launch handoff. Labels state that filters, selected rows, and row caps are display/Queue-action state only; Launch owns backend preflight, scope, schedule, and start authorization.
